description: We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 to $95,000 per year and is an excellent opportunity for a passionate nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development. We are looking to fill this role urgently with a candidate who is committed to upholding the highest standards of nursing practice and operational excellence.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care, and managing the nursing staff. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing nursing policies and procedures, maintaining compliance with all state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive and supportive work environment. This position requires a leader who can inspire their team while ensuring efficient and effective clinical services.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Proven experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience.
